author: Bartehh
body:
Hello!

So.. Where do I start, I'll just start with my first question because I only have two :)
This is more of a feedback, but somehow it won't let met post it in the "Server Feedback". So if you were wondering why I am posting it right here, that is my answer.

Now, let's start with my "Feedback" for the website. As you may know, on some server websites you can see when a rank is going to expire. My question is: Why shouldn't WE add that aswell on our beautifull Avicus Network website. It would be good for the "Gold/Emerald" ranks because then they can see when their rank, that they bought, will expire.
It is just some feedback, because I hear alot of Donators on the server that are asking that. I've seen this post once again. But I did not think they've seen the post.

That's why I am asking that once again. It would be great if the (Website) Dev's could add that for in the future. So people can see when their ranks are expiring. (Sorry for my bad English, it is not that terrible, but you know what I mean. I apologize for it.) 

I hope to see this in the feature for the website.
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Now let's just start with the other question I had planned to say. 
I am thinking of buying a rank this summer (it's not important to read this part for members & stuff). But first of all I would like to know if there are coming anymore new ranks (maybe this summer?!)

Because now we only have the regular ranks:
-Diamond [LIFETIME]
-Emerald [180 Days]
-Gold [30 Days]

But I think we should add ranks till $100,- Why? Simple if there will be Arcade games, such as an example:
-Paintball
-Spleef
-Etc.

There should be more ranks.
For example you will have:
-Gold [$15 - 30 Days]
-Emerald [$25 - 180 Days]
-Diamond [$50 - LIFETIME]
-Obsidian [$75 - LIFETIME] (Including more features & stuff)
-Bedrock [$100 - LIFETIME] (Including more features & stuff)  

I think more people will donate if they can get even more for their ranks, that they've bought. The reason is simple. Alot of people give about the server, and a lot of people want to donate for higher ranks. That's why I am giving this feedback TO the server. Because I really think if we would add more things to the higher ranks. People will start to donate, and stuff. And maybe then we will get more people on the server. 

You may will not read this carefully because this is a LONG post. But these 2 questions are REALLY important for me. 

I hope to see it, like I said, in the feature.


Thanks for reading this post, have a nice day!

Regards,
Bart E. [In-Game: _Nahz]
